title: Indigenous People's Day Weekend Firing - Walton Woodfire Kiln
commitment: Fri optional drop-off · Sat glazing and loading · Sun firing with stoking shifts · Mon wrapping by 2pm
bring: Bisqued or unfired pieces (1 cu ft maximum)
summary: A 30-36 hour wood firing at the off-grid Walton Woodfire kiln in Walton, NY with overnight stoking shifts available. Participants glaze and load Saturday, fire over Sunday-Monday, with optional Friday arrival.
source_quote: Indigenous People's Day Weekend Firing Oct 10-12... The Walton Woodfire kiln is an off grid firing experience, located in Walton, NY, 2.5 hours from the GWB.
evidence_sentence: The Woodfire Intensive page describes a wood firing at the Walton Woodfire kiln with loading Saturday and 30-36 hour firing Sunday-Monday with stoking opportunities.
evidence_quote: The Walton Woodfire kiln is an off grid firing experience... We anticipate around a 30-36 hr firing, so some lucky participants will get to helm the night shift firing at the kiln.
